name: Spatial Graph Adapter (SGA) Pattern
description: Diagram (this article has no graphical representation) | Intent: | Link to OWL File: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/HollyFerguson/Spatial-Graph-Adapter-Pattern/master/SGA\Protege\OWL.owlPDF of SGA Pattern Image: Image:USOcore3.pdfTo answer the modern, interdisciplinary questions asked within the Building domain, industry tools and data standards need to become f...
competency_questions: Which properties are recorded for a given building component, and what value does each of them have?; Which other building components does a given component share a recorded relationship with, and what kind of relationship is it?; Which separate records stand for the same physical object, and do they give it the same property values?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard 1.127.0 review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
